food-bufan-soup.prompt: Create one beautiful editorial watercolor and gouache FOOD ILLUSTRATION for a travel catalog. Landscape 3:2, single finished dish on a calm wooden restaurant table, elevated three-quarter close-up, natural soft daylight, carefully observed appetizing textures and subtle hand-painted brushwork. Clearly an illustration, not a claimed restaurant photo. Dish fills most of the frame. No lettering, logo, watermark, collage, inset, people, or raw ingredients. Subject: 洛阳不翻汤. Luoyang bufan tang: a rustic deep bowl of tangy peppery hot broth, several small very thin round mung-bean pancakes partially submerged, ribbon seaweed, translucent glass noodles, tiny dried shrimp, tofu strips, scallion and coriander, light dark vinegar-colored broth with a little chili oil. The small pancakes are delicate and thin, not thick American pancakes. Finished breakfast bowl.
